subject: New-main continuous-play preference feedback and localized About versus pending shared Audio/editor and lifecycle repairs
verdict: No concrete interaction defect found within the reviewed boundaries; source-only compatibility, not functional or native acceptance.
method: Read and hash-verified the exact nine-path main delta; reviewed all three changed canonical runtime modules in full.
Read actual main native-menu/control adoption and localization binding owners, plus exact pending Solo/Couch/shared Soundtrack settings and authoring lifecycle source.
Compared all seven lifecycle paths to their main base, reviewed new preference/tools controls without executing them.
No app, tests, build, generator, browser, filesystem writes, refs, PRs, dispatches or queue actions. Only this evidence Git blob was created.

findings.boundary: Gesture activation and existing Audio controls
findings.evidence: global-settings-view.mjs invoke calls operation() before inspecting then/rendering; this introduces no await before binding.set. native-menus.mjs:526-607 adopts real master controls/library nodes and preserves their existing handlers. Existing Solo setMasterMuted/setMasterVolume and Couch session/play paths remain independently owned. The new retry UI exists on synthetic fields, and feedback/retry are supplied only by continuous-play bindings in the reviewed mount.
findings.conclusion: No loss of original user gesture or rerouting of music Play/Studio/volume found.

findings.boundary: Selected Audio and lazy Studio owners
findings.evidence: soundtrack-panel.mjs at #1675:3779-3822 retains the connected identity, selected tab, hidden/inert, visibility and rendered rectangle checks. New preference render updates its own Gameplay row; it does not select/focus the Audio tab or mount Studio. #1675:1531-1580 and3607-3693 still bind authoring to dialog/visit/visibility and retire on close.
findings.conclusion: No path from preference save feedback or About localization to unwanted catalogue demand or late authoring mount found.

findings.evidence: continuousPlayBindings.retry calls only preferences.retry. It repeats a synchronous verified storage write, preserves pending local preferences, and notifies snapshot subscribers. createContinuousPlayController subscriber only cancels an active countdown/ready phase when disabled; it never dispatches from a preference notification. Solo app:1381-1386 only updates automaticNextEnabled and clears auto-advance when disabled.
findings.conclusion: Retry saving is not mission Retry and cannot accept Resume or advance simulation through this notification path.

findings.evidence: global-settings-tools.mjs changes About copy and registers the iframe title via localizedAttribute; src/showModal/close/focus/owner checks are unchanged. bootstrap.mjs:98-143 replaces the existing per-node title producer and updates only that attribute; it does not navigate or recreate the iframe.
findings.conclusion: No change to paused parent identity, child input ownership or accepted close/Resume boundaries found.

findings.evidence: The #1693 delta changes app pending action/pickup retirement around neutral Resume/recovery, Couch neutralActions consumption, Versus accepted Resume last=0, and Team accepted Start last=null. None of the nine new-main paths changes these owners; reviewed preference callbacks only cancel presentation auto-advance.
findings.conclusion: No identified clock/input ordering conflict with #1693. A combined native run remains required.

limits: This is a bounded source review, not an all-app proof and not a performance result.
No functional tests completed or executed in this review. Existing and new checks must be qualified against the eventual combined source.
The generated FPV projection was deliberately excluded because another reviewer owns that exact closure.
Native focus, media-activation policies, storage denial and actual browser pause/resume still require hosted/browser evidence.
